lessons.title: 2. BST Insert
lessons.description: Insert values into a binary search tree.

tests.name: test_bst_insert
tests.unittest_code:
def test_bst_insert(self):
    root = None
    for v in [5, 3, 7]:
        root = bst_insert(root, v)
    self.assertEqual(root.value, 5)
    self.assertEqual(root.left.value, 3)
    self.assertEqual(root.right.value, 7)

lessons.title: 3. BST Contains (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: BST search challenge: implement bst_contains(root, value). Start at the root; while the current node exists, compare value with cur.value — go right when value is larger, left when smaller, and return True on an exact match. Reaching a None child means the value is not in the tree. Tests: the tree 5(3, 7) contains 7 (True) but not 4 (False).

tests.name: test_bst_contains
tests.unittest_code:
def test_bst_contains(self):
    root = TreeNode(5, TreeNode(3), TreeNode(7))
    self.assertTrue(bst_contains(root, 7))
    self.assertFalse(bst_contains(root, 4))

lessons.title: 4. Tree Height (Practice)
lessons.description: Return the height of a binary tree (empty tree height 0).

tests.name: test_height
tests.unittest_code:
def test_height(self):
    root = TreeNode(1, TreeNode(2, TreeNode(3)), TreeNode(4))
    self.assertEqual(height(root), 3)
    self.assertEqual(height(None), 0)

lessons.title: 5. Unit 6 Checkpoint: Trees & BST
lessons.description: Validate whether a tree is a BST (strict: left < node < right for all nodes).
learning_objectives: Track allowed value ranges while recursing

tests.name: test_is_bst
tests.unittest_code:
def test_is_bst(self):
    good = TreeNode(2, TreeNode(1), TreeNode(3))
    bad = TreeNode(2, TreeNode(3), TreeNode(1))
    self.assertTrue(is_bst(good))
    self.assertFalse(is_bst(bad))
